# Spiking_Decoder_Tracking

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neural network-based decoder that converts spike trains from event-based sensors into bounding box predictions for object tracking. Enables energy-efficient, event-driven tracking without dense frame processing, critical for real-time neuromorphic vision systems.
